Package com.robojacks.lib.hal

Interface Hardware

All Known Implementing Classes:
HydrozoaHardware, SimHardware
public interface Hardware
Everything robot code needs from the brain. One implementation talks to Hydrozoa, another is a desktop simulator. Robot code never imports a vendor API directly.
